clusters.headline: Pope Leo XIV Addresses Austerity Concerns During Argentina Visit
aiSummaryBullets: An estimated 2.5 million people gathered for an open-air mass led by Pope Leo XIV in Buenos Aires.
The Pope publicly criticized current national austerity measures, emphasizing that economic growth must be inclusive.

clusters.headline: Paraguay Seeks International Aid To Trace Missing Ueno Bank Funds
aiSummaryBullets: Paraguay has requested international cooperation to track assets allegedly diverted from the collapsed Ueno Bank.
The Paraguayan public prosecutor is coordinating with Argentina, the United States, and Luxembourg on the investigation.

clusters.headline: Passing Of Argentine Cultural Activist Gustavo Freiberg Reported
aiSummaryBullets: Gustavo Freiberg, an Argentine cultural activist, has died in Brazil.
Freiberg was a political exile who established an art studio in the Vila Madalena neighborhood of Sao Paulo.
